answer: The registry accepts one retirement per serial. Each key must retire one unique opal and post an 18 POA bond. The board keeps one anchor per opal, and the key files a jade, the signed retirement certificate bound to that opal and key. A second jade on the same anchor, a reused opal, or a jade that names the wrong key burns the 18 POA bond. A farm of 350 keys that can retire only five opal files only five jade, so 345 keys each burn 18 POA: 345 x 18 = 6,210 POA the attacker forfeits.
